messages:
maria: Quick sync — LangChain + Gatebridge want to co-announce our Gateway Connector next week. Need final go/no-go by Wed EOD. Draft plan below.

raj: timeline ok for eng? what’s the hard blocker?

maria: eng signoff on end-to-end demo, marketplace listing copy, and a tiny privacy wording for Gatebridge. marketing + legal also need to OK.

olivia: marketing can draft announcement + blog. can we get a 30s demo video? if so we can push to socials same day. :camera_flash:

sam: demo is doable but need a stable sandbox image and an auth flow example for SI partners. i can carve out an env by Tue.

kai: i’ll own the sandbox image. clarifying Q: do we need GPU-backed images for the demo (hardware partners)?

maria: yes — Gatebridge wants to show latency with a DGX-ish instance. we can do a lightweight perf clip (10–20s). partner-ops, can you confirm HW availability?

partner-ops: partner-ops: confirmed with HW partner — one reserved A100 node Wed morning for 2 hours. booking id: PB-4821.

chloe: legal reviewed the partner wording, they flagged data-retention line. suggested tweak: "no customer data is stored post-demo unless explicitly opted in". ok for partners?

raj: eng fine with that wording. only ask: add a note about KV cache being disabled in demo to avoid side effects.

maria: noted. adding to checklist.

maria: checklist (draft):
```
- eng: stable sandbox image (kai) — Tue EOD
- eng: demo auth example + disable KV cache (sam) — Wed AM
- marketing: blog + social drafts + 30s demo clip (olivia) — Wed noon
- legal: partner wording signoff (chloe) — Wed EOD
- partnerships: marketplace listing + joint press coord (maria) — Wed EOD
- ops: hw reservation confirmed (partner-ops) — done
- release: coordinated publish time + fallback plan (deploy-bot)
```

olivia: I'll put a draft blog + tweet thread in the marketing drive by Tue night. need one technical quote from eng and a short customer-blurb (can be internal).

sam: working on auth snippet. will post a tiny code sample in thread when ready.

sam: code sample (dev sandbox auth):
```
POST https://sandbox.redwood.example/auth
Content-Type: application/json
{ "client_id": "gw-demo", "scopes": ["generate","embedding"] }
```

maria: nice. add a note to docs team to pin the gateway compatibility matrix page: https://docs.redwood.com/gateway-compat

kai: sandbox image will include the LangChain connector + LlamaIndex index sample. size ~1.2GB. pushing to registry Tue 6pm.

raj: testing plan: run 3 demo scenarios (LLM chat, embeddings sync, rerank) — sam + raj pair to run on Wed AM against HW node.

chloe: legal: also need partner logos approved for marketplace card. can partners share SVGs by Tue EOD?

maria: already asked — Gatebridge said they'll send assets by Tue noon. LangChain will confirm via their comms lead.

partner-ops: reminder: blackout window Thu 00:00-04:00 UTC for infra maintenance. avoid publishing then.

olivia: suggested publish window: Wed 17:00 UTC to hit US/EU peak. thoughts?

sam: agreed. ensures we can catch any issues before close-of-day US.

maria: fallback plan if demo fails: publish announcement but hide demo video and badge marketplace as "coming soon". ops: are rollback hooks in place?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback hook template exists. run `./scripts/rollback_announcements.sh <id>` to retract assets.

raj: final ask: can we get an internal dry-run on Tue 18:00 UTC with marketing + partners on the call? helps catch copy + demo gaps.

maria: scheduling a 30min dry-run Tue 18:00 UTC. invite will go to this thread.

olivia: adding a checklist column for owner + status in the shared sheet. i'll post the link shortly.

sam: will dump the auth example + short runbook into the sheet after image publish.

maria: perfect — thanks team. tagging @Gatebridge and @LangChain comms after we have final assets. updates in this thread only please. :raised_hands:
